Resolves #5621

`floating` was decided at construction and never again. `getBaseClass()` contributes `neo-floating` to every `cls` write, which covers a component born floating — but nothing writes `cls` when only `floating` changes, and the config was not reactive, so a flip left the component reporting `floating: true` while still rendering `position: static`. It is now `floating_`, with an `afterSetFloating` that toggles the class through the existing `toggleCls`, aligns a mounted component on the way in, and **releases that alignment on the way out** through a new `DomAccess#unalign`. Construction and reads are unchanged: the eight consumers declaring `floating: true` as a class config — Picker, Tooltip, Toast, Dialog, Button, Button.Effect, `menu.List`, the tab Overflow plugin — construct exactly as before.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms over the live config system, red-first in both directions) → L2 required (AC-1 … AC-3, AC-5); L3 (a mounted component in a real window, through the App Worker config path, red-first) → L3 required (AC-4); L3 for AC-6 (components + e2e engine tiers). Residual: none.

## Deltas from ticket

The ticket body was one sentence from 2024 and carried no Contract Ledger or ACs. I derived the ledger from source and posted it with the intake verdict — [issue comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/5621#issuecomment-5668425959). `ticket-intake` §7 names "author or maintainer" as who writes it, so that is within the rule; what I got wrong was posting it after branching rather than before.

One fork in the ticket's phrasing — *"add or remove the cmp from the given layout"* — resolved toward the narrow reading: **DOM ownership does not move.** `parentId` is the config that roots a component elsewhere, and `tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs:1163` sets `floating` and `parentId` together precisely because they are separate facts.

`afterSetFloating` aligns but does not focus. `afterSetMounted` does both because a floating widget *appearing* is a popup; a component already on screen that changes how it is positioned is not that event.

**Round 1 found the exit half missing.** Turning floating off removed the class but left what `DomAccess#align` had done: the inline `transform` and `top`/`left`, the `neo-aligned-*` zone class, and the registration that keeps a subject aligned on resize and scroll — `syncAligns` only releases a subject that has left the document. `DomAccess#unalign` is the inverse. It ends the registration, restores the configured sizing through the existing `resetDimensions` from the registered spec, and puts back the owner's own `left`, `top` and `transform`. The release half of `syncAligns` moves into `removeAligned`, which both paths share.

Not addressed, and not made worse: this adds one more `addCls`/`removeCls` owner to the shared `cls` bag, on the precedent `ui`, `disabled` and the Button hooks already set. That ownership debt is #15197 / D#15200.

## Test Evidence

**Class arms, red-first against unchanged source:** 3 failed — flipping on adds the class, flipping off removes it, a Button keeps its base classes — while 2 passed — created-floating carries the class, the default does not. The passing pair are the construction-time controls, so the red is the runtime flip and not the rig. After: **5 passed**.

**Mounted round trip, red-first at `1f161475aa`:** a 100×30 probe in a 40px-padded container, aligned `t0-b0` to `{x:250, y:180, width:100, height:60}`, then floating turned off.

| after `floating: false` | at `1f161475aa` | at `8fcb2b911b` |
|---|---|---|
| position | static | static |
| client origin | **290, 280** | 40, 40 |
| inline transform | **`translate(250px, 240px)`** | `''` |
| zone class | **`neo-aligned-bottom`** | none |
| still registered | **true** | false |

At `8fcb2b911b` the DOM parent, the sibling's position and the focused element all match the pre-float state, and a viewport resize after release leaves the probe unaligned.
